authentication: shared service bearer credential on literal loopback; remote deployment requires TLS before enabling remote addresses

python_service.execution_transport: grpc only; HTTP exposes health, readiness and authenticated capabilities

result_policy: Go verifies all identity fields and size before an attempt can commit; expired, cancelled, foreign or replaced attempts cannot commit results
deployment_policy: Optional workers have no database credentials. Core domain routes require neither worker. This allowlisted foundation does not accept arbitrary user code.

investigation.result_policy: Go QA plus existing durable job attempt fencing; inconclusive and human review only
